content.contractStatement: This architecture contract defines the material authority, transport mechanism, and structural boundaries for the define-product-intent desk in accordance with ADR-053, CONVEYOR-MENTAL-MODEL principles, and formalization scenario requirements.

corePrinciples.statement: The define-product-intent desk operates as an authoritative source for product intent artifacts (brief and PRD containers). All product intent material maintains authority through immutable Workplace production revisions, not individual WorkerExecution instances.

WorkerExecution serves only as provenance authority for product intent authoring, not material authority. Execution references track who contributed to intent evolution but never for retrieving the final accepted intent state.

Before any product intent material crosses QC boundaries, the Workplace must seal an immutable WorkplaceProductionRevision. This revision captures the exact state of brief and PRD containers with all atomic intent members and becomes the sole authority for downstream requirements definition.

All material transport between define-product-intent desk components uses content address referencing. Product intent identity is determined solely by cryptographic content digest, never by mutable identifiers, execution IDs, or path references.

scope: Direct Artifacts: Brief container, PRD container with atomic intent members
Atomic Intent Members: System boundary, actors, outcomes, scope, constraints, unknowns
Trace Relationships: All derivation, constraint, and resolution relationships
Architectural References: ADR-053, CONVEYOR-MENTAL-MODEL, formalization scenario plan
Contract Outputs: Sealed intent revisions ready for model-use-cases Cell

transportMechanism: Intent Artifact Creation: Author produces brief/PRD → SHA256 digest computed
Member-Level Addressing: Individual atomic intent members get their own digests
Container-Level Addressing: PRD container gets overall digest
Revision Sealing: WorkplaceProductionRevision records all content digests
Transport Downstream: Only content digests travel across boundaries
Verification: Recompute SHA256 on receipt to verify intent integrity
Authority Resolution: Resolve content digest to exact intent artifact state
acceptanceCriteria: All product intent artifacts are content-addressed with SHA256 digests
No downstream component reads intent by execution ID
Intent material transport uses content digests only
Provenance (execution refs) is separate from intent material authority
Hybrid granularity: container and member digests both transportable
0 accepted upstream revisions travel by content address
Brief and PRD containers contain all required atomic intent members
compliance: ADR-053: Accepted material is a sealed Workplace production revision; WorkerExecution is provenance only
